classificationCaveats: Mapping is at suite-family level. It does not assert that every example in a mapped suite protects every listed invariant.
Names and counts are inventory evidence only; they are not redundancy evidence.
broad-acceptance-candidate and routine-correctness are conservative suite-level decisions, not implemented lane metadata.
committedVisibility is a source-inspection assessment. required is reserved for an explicit concurrency or separate-context path; possible requires follow-up proof.

invariantCatalog.requirement: Venue bootstrap and owner/admin assignment flow.
Public signup does not grant privileged venue access.
Profile-completion gate behavior.
Venue-membership role restrictions.
Global users fields do not bypass venue membership checks.
Venue isolation on reads and writes.
Export permission restrictions.
Draft versus live visibility behavior.
Manager/Admin publish permissions.
Week-copy creates a draft target.
Conflict detection ordering and rendering.
Late-to-Early start-to-start threshold logic.
15-minute exact increment validation.
Approval reset on staff edit of approved entry.
Leave date validation and status transitions.
Conflict recalculation after leave approval.
Correction history or audit event creation for approval and record changes.
Prohibition of silent destructive edits once records are in business use.
Role changes create durable history or audit coverage.
Pay level override precedence.
Weekday window segmentation correctness.
Weekend multiplier and penalty stacking correctness.
Break deduction behavior.
Historical calculations remain reproducible after later pay/config changes.
Exported pay outputs include enough versioning/metadata to explain later.
Venue admin bulk-save creates a new pay/config snapshot without erasing prior versions.
Configured recurring Stripe Price is active, AUD 100/month, fixed quantity.
Stripe create requests use idempotency keys.
Checkout/Portal construction uses strict local mocks without live CI credentials.
Webhook signatures are verified from the raw body before JSON parsing.
Webhook events are deduplicated by event ID.
Subscription lifecycle fixtures cover created, updated, deleted, failed payment, duplicate.
Billing storage/logs omit sensitive payment and full raw payload data by default.
Operator sandbox validation with Stripe CLI/test clocks is documented before launch.
